notes.title: Version 0.1.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Realm boss encounter
[*] Added chest encounters
[*] Added item recombination
[*] Added new rune: Rune of Honing
[*] Added a guide detailing mechanics
[*] Reduced Normal difficulty and added Hard, Brutal, and Merciless difficulties
[*] Stick is now Club
[*] Items and units with abilities now have an ability icon
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added audio effects to many combat events
[*] Added highlighting to selection options and inventory items
[*] Added boon for next run after loss
[*] Fixed bug with multiple applications when selecting unit
[*] Fixed bug with combat effects not reseting on combat reengage
[*] Fixed bug with Lifesteal gained On Kill being lost when second attack with Double Strike was canceled
[*] Incremental performance and UI improvements
[/list]
